in_marathi.name: Adhik
in_marathi.long_meaning: Adhik हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Adhik is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Adhika' which means 'Lord' or 'Master'. In Hindu mythology, Adhik is believed to be the name of various gods and deities. For instance, Lord Vishnu is also known as Adhik Narayan or Adhikeshwara, meaning 'Lord of the Universe'. The name Adhik is considered auspicious and is often given to boys to signify their position as the head of the family or community.
